note: Step 2 validation set. Each entry probes a specific way the pipeline could break, not just 'another show'. Silo and The Expanse — the only shows validated so far — are the easiest possible case: prestige serialised sci-fi, dense Wikipedia coverage, 10-13 episode seasons, clean causal plots. Everything below is chosen to break that assumption somewhere.
